description: Generic commenter talent sieve: classifies people who commented on a public hiring post as hire targets vs peers vs brand accounts, scores their depth in the target role, names their level and primary specialty. Instantiated below for a Head of Content role; to retarget, rewrite the role_depth criteria with the new role's proof signals, rename role_level labels to that function's ladder, and replace the primary_specialty options with that role's specialties. Text + profile image. A bio can show depth, leadership level, and specialty focus; it cannot show work history, promotions, or tenure, so this sieve never claims them.

eval.criteria: 12 or more builder-produced states drawn from the actual commenter pool, enriched by the same builder used for the live batch. Labels assigned by hand from the same bio+image evidence the classifier receives: strong senior operators must route OUTREACH_TOP, real practitioners must route OUTREACH, peers must route RELATIONSHIPS, brands and people with no role depth must route PARK. Eval checks slot only; specialty, level, and image answers ride in meta.
eval.note: Any question change invalidates the eval (config hash) and closes the gate until the eval is re-run.

requires: State profile_image as a jevimg:///abs/path.jpg string; the Jev CLI converts it to an assets-map reference and sends the image with the request (image mode upgrades the model automatically)
JPEG profile images upscaled so the small dimension is >= 288px, inside the image API limits

name: commenter_talent_scan

criteria.brand_account: A company, agency, product, publication, or organization account. Not a person.
criteria.hire_target: An individual practitioner or operator who could plausibly join as an employee: function lead, strategist, senior specialist, consultant, freelancer, or small-agency owner who does the work.
criteria.peer_partner: A founder/CEO of a notable company, a celebrity of the niche, or an industry name you would partner with or book as a guest, not hire.

account_kind.instructions: This person commented on a hiring post for the target role. Decide the hiring bucket. A big audience alone does not make someone a peer: a working operator with a large following is a hire_target. A founder/CEO of a notable company, or a celebrity whose own brand is the business, is a peer_partner. When genuinely ambiguous between hire_target and peer_partner, prefer hire_target: a conversation resolves it.

criteria.instagram: Instagram: reels and short-form on Instagram, IG growth, personal-brand content on Instagram
criteria.podcast: Podcast production or growth is the main specialty
criteria.tiktok: TikTok: TikTok-first short-form or TikTok growth
criteria.unclear: No specialty signal in the bio
criteria.written: Newsletter, X, LinkedIn, blogs, or written content is the main specialty
criteria.youtube: YouTube: long-form, YouTube strategy, retention, titles/thumbnails, channel growth

primary_specialty.instructions: Which specialty is this person strongest in, from the bio and display name? Pick the single strongest signal. If they are clearly professional across two or more specialties, pick multi_area. If there is no specialty signal at all, pick unclear. REPLACE the options below with your role's specialties before use; the set shipped here is the content-role instantiation (channels).

profile_is_logo.instructions: Look at the image in profile_image. Is it primarily a business logo, wordmark, or designed graphic rather than a photograph? Answer yes if the image is a logo or graphic design (including a logo overlaid on a photo). Answer no if it is mainly a photograph of a person, place, or object.

criteria: 0 = no work in the role at all: unrelated job, personal account, fan, student, or a generic apply commenter with no role signal in the bio
1 = weak / adjacent: mentions the field as one vague item, or is a hobbyist with no professional proof, clients, or results
2 = plausible practitioner: a clear hands-on job or freelance offer in the field, with some clients or work, but no leadership or standout results
3 = strong: the field is the main focus and the level is senior: leads the function for a creator, brand or agency, runs a channel with a real audience, or states growth results
4 = elite proven operator: leads the function at a high level, with named notable clients or brands, large audiences grown, or hard numbers (views, subscribers, revenue) in the bio
role_depth.instructions: How deep and proven is this person's work in the target role (here: content leadership)? Read the bio, display name, and profile image. Count real work in the role: running or growing channels for creators or brands, content strategy, production systems, audience growth numbers, views, revenue or client proof. The profile image in profile_image is weak supporting evidence only: a real professional presence or a studio brand mark supports it, a default avatar weakens it.

criteria.own_brand_only: Primarily produces for their own brand or audience, with no evidence of doing this work for others
criteria.practitioner: Hands-on maker or operator doing the work day to day
criteria.senior_specialist: Strategist, lead, manager, or senior consultant who owns strategy or accounts, short of function-head level
criteria.team_lead: Leads the function or a team: Head of, Director, VP, or clearly owns the function for a creator, brand, or agency
criteria.unclear: The bio does not show a level in the role, or the account is not a person

role_level.instructions: What level does this person's work in the target role read as, from the bio alone? Pick the closest. If the account is a brand or the bio shows no work in the role, pick unclear.

criteria: 0 = default avatar, blank, or too pixelated to read
1 = amateur: cluttered graphic, low-resolution snapshot, or random unrelated image
2 = acceptable but generic: clean simple logo or ordinary snapshot
3 = polished: professional headshot/photo or a clean, well-designed logo
4 = premium: clearly professionally produced brand identity or photography
visual_brand_quality.instructions: Judge only the production polish of the profile image in profile_image as a brand signal. Do not judge any person's appearance or attractiveness.
